arxiv-2204-07488.title: Quantum Anomalous Hall and Valley Quantum Anomalous Hall Effects in Two-Dimensional d 0 Orbital XY Monolayers
arxiv-2204-07488.creator: Kang Wang, Yihui Li, Haoliang Mei, Ping Li, Zhi-Xin Guo
arxiv-2204-07488.description: Abstract We propose a new family of the d 0 orbital XY (X = K, Rb, Cs; Y = N, P, As, Sb, Bi) monolayers with abundant and novel topology and valley properties. The KN, RbN, RbP, RbAs, CsP, CsAs, and CsSb monolayers possess remarkable quantum anomalous Hall effect (QAHE). CsSb monolayer also exhibits extraordinary valley QAHE with giant splitting.

arxiv-2311-16979.title: Mirković-Vilonen Polytopes From Combinatorics
arxiv-2311-16979.creator: Mario Sanchez
arxiv-2311-16979.description: Abstract . Mirković-Vilonen (MV) polytopes are a class of generalized permutahedra originating from geometric representation theory. In this paper we study MV polytopes coming from matroid polytopes, flag matroid polytopes, Bruhat interval polytopes, and Schubitopes. We give classifications and combinatorial conditions for when these polytopes are MV polytopes.

arxiv-2502-17585.title: Synergizing Deep Learning and Full-Waveform Inversion: Bridging Data-Driven and Theory-Guided Approaches for Enhanced Seismic Imaging
arxiv-2502-17585.creator: Christopher Zerafa, Pauline Galea, Cristiana Sebu
arxiv-2502-17585.description: Abstract Seismic imaging and subsurface characterization play vital roles in understanding Earth’s geological properties. This review paper explores the integration of deep learning techniques with full-waveform inversion (FWI), a critical method for estimating subsurface properties using seismic data. The paper is structured into five chapters that cover the theoretical foundations, applications, challenges, limitations, and future research directions of this integration.

pmc-10700547.title: Simulation-predicted and -explained inheritance model of pathogenicity confirmed by transgenic mice models
pmc-10700547.creator: Cheng-Yu Tsai, Ying-Chang Lu, Yen-Hui Chan, Navaneethan Radhakrishnan, Yuan-Yu Chang, Shu-Wha Lin, Tien-Chen Liu, Chuan-Jen Hsu, Pei-Lung Chen, Lee-Wei Yang, Chen-Chi Wu
pmc-10700547.description: Variants in the gap junction beta-2 (GJB2) gene are the most common cause of hereditary hearing impairment. However, how GJB2 variants lead to local physicochemical and structural changes in the hexameric ion channels of connexin 26 (Cx26), resulting in hearing impairment, remains elusive.

pmc-11272917.title: Tofersen decreases neurofilament levels supporting the pathogenesis of the SOD1 p.D91A variant in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis patients
pmc-11272917.creator: Jochen H. Weishaupt, Péter Körtvélyessy, Peggy Schumann, Ivan Valkadinov, Ute Weyen, Jasper Hesebeck-Brinckmann, Kanchi Weishaupt, Matthias Endres, Peter M. Andersen, Martin Regensburger, Marie Dreger, Jan C. Koch, Julian Conrad, Thomas Meyer
pmc-11272917.description: BackgroundSince the antisense oligonucleotide tofersen has recently become available for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) caused by mutations in SOD1, determining the causality of the over 230 SOD1 variants has become even more important. The most common SOD1 variant worldwide is p.D91A (c.272A > C), whose causality for ALS is contested when in a heterozygous state.

pmc-11289094.title: Experimental investigation of earth-air heat exchanger using porous clay vessels for eco-friendly buildings
pmc-11289094.creator: Emad M. S. El-Said, Gamal B. Abdelaziz, Mohamed I. M. Abdelhady, Nadia shokry, Sherif Mohamed, Mohamed A. Dahab
pmc-11289094.description: This study introduces an experimental investigation of a novel direct trend evaporative cooler based on a ground-air heat exchanger (GAHE) using porous clay vessels as an evaporation media under a variety of operational conditions, including air flow rate, inlet air temperature, temperature of inlet water, and in air humidity.

pmc-11841500.title: A low-protein soybean-free diet improves carcass traits and meat quality and modulates the colonic microbiota in Daweizi pigs
pmc-11841500.creator: Haohua Fu, Taoming Yang, Hengjia Ni, Jing Li, Fenfen Liu, Jingbo Liu, Yulong Yin
pmc-11841500.description: IntroductionSoybean meal is an excellent protein source and is widely used in pig feed. However, the Americas account for more than 80% of global soybean production, so European and Asia swine production largely depends on soybean imports. The use of safe and functional unconventional feed sources can effectively alleviate worldwide protein shortage problems.

pmc-12669640.creator: Catherine Kennon, Joanne M Wood, Philippe F Lacherez, Alex A Black, Damian Cuda, Emily Henry, Allison M McKendrick
pmc-12669640.description: Motion perception is an important visual process involved in driving, and has been associated with daytime driving performance, however, few studies have investigated the association of motion perception with night driving. This study examined the relationship between motion perception and performance on a computer-based off-road Night-time Hazard Visibility Test (NHVT) in 70 licensed drivers (M = 53.4 ± 23.

pmc-12695654.title: Stable clonal contribution of lineage-restricted stem cells to human hematopoiesis
pmc-12695654.creator: Tetsuichi Yoshizato, Christer Nilsson, Francesca Grasso, Kari Högstrand, Stefania Mazzi, Axel Winroth, Madeleine Lehander, Indira Barbosa, Gunilla Waldin, Teresa Mortera-Blanco, Monika Jansson, Mikaela Hillberg Widfeldt, Affaf Aliouat, Margs S Brennan, Ellen Markljung, Amy Hillen, Edwin Chari, Eva H
pmc-12695654.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Dynamic steady-state lineage contribution of human hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) clones needs to be assessed over time. However, clonal contribution of HSCs has only been investigated at single time points and without assessing the critical erythroid and platelet lineages. Here we screened for somatic mutations in healthy aged individuals, identifying expanded HSC clones accessible for lineage tracing of all major blood cell lineages.

pmc-13017167.title: Cross-Calibration of Bone Mineral Density and Body Composition between GE Lunar Prodigy and Hologic Horizon W Dual Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Systems
pmc-13017167.creator: Sujin Kim, Guen Young Lee, Jun-Il Yoo, Sang-Wook Lee, Yong-Chan Ha
pmc-13017167.description: BackgroundDual energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) measurements vary among instruments from different manufacturers. This study aimed to assess the correlation between bone mineral density (BMD) and body composition measured by the GE Lunar Prodigy and Hologic Horizon W DXA systems and to develop conversion equations.

pmc-13249056.title: T-cell-targeted immunotherapy in neurofibromatosis type 2-related vestibular schwannoma: current evidence and future direction
pmc-13249056.creator: Reygn J Done, Omar Ahmid, Miriam J Smith, D Gareth Evans, Omar N Pathmanaban, David Brough, Kevin N Couper
pmc-13249056.description: Neurofibromatosis type 2-related schwannomatosis is a rare tumour predisposition syndrome caused by loss-of-function pathogenic variants within the NF2 gene, which encodes the tumour suppressor protein merlin. This leads to development of benign tumours within the nervous system, most notably vestibular schwannomas that form on the vestibulocochlear (eighth cranial) nerve.

pmc-13599117.title: Microplastics in human ovarian follicular fluid: a pilot Raman spectroscopy study
pmc-13599117.creator: Kálmán Kovács, Réka A. Vass, Leila Takács, József Bódis, András Lukács, Szilvia Barkó
pmc-13599117.description: BackgroundMicroplastics (MPs) have recently been identified in multiple human biological matrices, including placenta, blood, breast milk, semen, and testicular tissue, raising concerns regarding their potential endocrine, inflammatory, and reproductive effects. Despite this rapidly expanding field, the ovarian follicular microenvironment remains largely understudied, and data on the direct presence of MPs in human follicular fluid (FF) are limited.
